title: Tracking down the 16-year-old WAL-reset SQLite bug
summary: This article details the discovery and root-cause analysis of a 16-year-old SQLite bug involving WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) reset, which caused data corruption under specific crash conditions. The author explains the intricate interplay between file locking, checkpointing, and WAL reset, and provides a workaround. It's a deep dive into database internals, not directly AI/ML, but relevant for building reliable AI data pipelines.
